enrichment.name: Asv Crn Business Park
enrichment.config_mix: commercial office floor plates (~17,700 sqft per floor, Basement + Stilt + 9 floors)
enrichment.density_note: single Grade-A office block, ~1,60,000 sqft total leasable
enrichment.notes: IMPORTANT CORRECTION: this is NOT an apartment project — it is a commercial/office business park on Mount Poonamallee High Road opposite Chennai Trade Centre, ~1,60,000 sqft leasable across Basement+Stilt+9 floors with ~17,700 sqft floor plates. No pricing found: every listing (NoBroker, CityInfo, JLL, CBRE) shows 'Price on Request' for both lease and sale, so all price/ticket fields are null. Amenities: fire safety, service lifts, CCTV, power backup, metro station adjacent, ~13 km from airport.

enrichment.name: Brigade West Chennai JDA project (working name)
enrichment.density_note: 6.6-acre premium residential development, unit count not disclosed
enrichment.notes: No pricing or configuration published — the JDA announcement only confirms a 6.6-acre parcel in West Chennai on a 'major arterial corridor' with GDV of Rs 1,000 crore (Rs 10 billion), launch expected in 2026 subject to approvals. Brigade MD Pavitra Shankar calls Chennai its second-largest market; plans cite 'thoughtfully designed apartments', lifestyle amenities and ESG-aligned infrastructure. Exact micro-market within West Chennai is still unstated in all sources I found.

enrichment.name: Cambridge By Dac
enrichment.notes: RERA TNRERA/29/BLG/0041/2026 confirmed on multiple portals, so identity is certain. 2 BHK 958 sqft from ~Rs 83 lakh, 3 BHK up to 1,591 sqft at ~Rs 1.48-1.56 crore; portals quote Rs 8,663-9,200/sqft (one source shows a wider Rs 8.7K-10.8K band). Gated community with pool, gym, clubhouse, multipurpose hall, cricket net, kids play area; developer is offering no pre-EMI till possession. Walkable to OMR IT hubs and SIPCOT.

enrichment.name: The Lord'S By Dac
enrichment.density_note: low-density villa community, 117 villas on 5.5 acres (~21/acre)
enrichment.notes: IMPORTANT CORRECTION: this is a VILLA project, not apartments, and it sits in Pudupakkam behind Siruseri SIPCOT on the OMR side rather than GST Road. DAC's own site confirms RERA TNRERA/35/BLG/0146/2026 dated 25.04.2026 and Rs 1.65 Cr onwards for 3 & 4 BHK villas; findbhk gives the full 1,425-2,529 sqft / Rs 1.65-2.55 Cr band, 117 units, 5.5 acres, Jan-2027 possession. Note the project also carries a separate layout registration TNRERA/35/LO/0473/2026. London-inspired master layout, zen planning, clubhouse, pool, gym, amphitheatre, yoga deck, EV charging, underground utilities. One portal (addressofchoice) quotes a lower Rs 40-70 lakh band which appears to be the land/UDS component only — treat the Rs 1.65 Cr+ figure as the all-in villa price.

enrichment.name: Kshetra
enrichment.density_note: large plotted township, ~900-966 plots across 54 acres
enrichment.notes: LOCATION CORRECTION: G Square's own project page carries RERA TNRERA/2/LO/1304/2026 (identity confirmed) but places Kshetra at KARANODAI — 200 m off GNT Road, 2 min from ORR, 10 min from Redhills Junction — i.e. NORTH Chennai in Thiruvallur district, not the far-west Thiruvallur town corridor. G Square's two own pages disagree slightly: one says 603 sqft onwards / Rs 1,690 psf / 966 plots, the other 707 sqft onwards / Rs 1,890 psf / 903 plots, so I have given the spanning range. Ready-to-construct plots with clear titles, 50-70 amenities, black-topped internal roads, streetlights, 24x7 CCTV, 1 year free maintenance, cricket nets, party lawn, kids zone, plus G Square's Build Assist construction support.

enrichment.name: Kg Fields Of Fortune
enrichment.density_note: mid-size plotted township, 482 plots on ~30 acres
enrichment.notes: RERA TNRERA/2/LO/2356/2026 confirmed on portal listings, identity certain. Exact site is Pudur Road, KUTHAMBAKKAM (Poonamallee taluk, Tiruvallur district) rather than Poonamallee town itself — worth noting in the tracker. CMDA-approved, plots described as ready-to-register/ready-to-construct. Price per sqft is quoted as Rs 3,500 by findbhk and Rs 4,000 by chennaiproperties, giving a ticket band of roughly Rs 22-73.4 lakh. Amenities: black-top roads, streetlights, multipurpose court, kids play area, outdoor gym, walking track, amphitheatre, party lawn, maze seating, avenue trees, compound wall, 24x7 security, rainwater harvesting.

enrichment.name: Prestige Medavakkam (working name, Bharatnagar Buildcon LLP land)
enrichment.notes: TREAT PRICING AS INDICATIVE ONLY. The land deal is well documented: Prestige acquired 66.93% of Bharatnagar Buildcon LLP (Prestige Falcon Realty 63.12% + Prestige Projects 3.81%) for Rs 938.75 crore on 10 Dec 2025, giving ~25 acres in Medavakkam, ~5 msf developable, GDV Rs 5,000 crore+. The pricing above comes from an unofficial channel-partner site marketing 'Prestige Falcon City Chennai' on Medavakkam-Sholinganallur Road — Rs 10,800/sqft, 1,001-2,735 sqft, Rs 1.30-3.54 Cr, 2,170 units in 22 towers, official launch and RERA both said to be due 15 Dec 2026. I could NOT confirm that Falcon City is the same Bharatnagar Buildcon parcel (that site says 23 acres vs the 25 acres reported for the acquisition), and Prestige has published nothing official — another aggregator lists 'Prestige Medavakkam' 25 acres with price strictly 'on request' and Dec-2028 possession. Medavakkam market rate is currently Rs 8,500-12,500/sqft, so the quoted figure is at least plausible.

enrichment.name: Shriram Swargam
enrichment.notes: LOCATION NOTE: portals place Swargam in THIRUMAZHISAI (West Chennai) rather than Poonamallee proper, though it is in the Poonamallee corridor with ORR and Chennai-Bengaluru Highway access. Config-wise: 1 BHK 604 sqft from ~Rs 26 lakh, 2 BHK 937 sqft from ~Rs 35 lakh, 3 BHK 1,328 sqft from ~Rs 51 lakh — one of the cheapest entry tickets in the dataset. SOURCE CONFLICT on rate and land: channel-partner listings imply ~Rs 3,900-4,300/sqft on 4.59 acres, while AurumProptech quotes ~Rs 5,200/sqft, Rs 45 lakh onwards, 8.87 acres and a May-2028 handover; most sources still say 'RERA under process', which the new TNRERA/2/BLG/0220/2026 registration now supersedes. Amenities: pool, clubhouse, gym, yoga/meditation deck, amphitheatre, sports court, jogging track, retail shops, 24x7 CCTV, power backup.

enrichment.name: Urbanrise Codename 'The Next Big Thing' (reported as Codename New Porur, Thirumazhisai)
enrichment.density_note: 1,000+ apartments in launch phase alone; large township format
enrichment.notes: DATA-QUALITY WARNING: the tracker record conflates two different Urbanrise projects. 'Urbanrise Codename New Porur' is an OLDER, now READY-TO-MOVE project in Thirumazhisai (RERA TN/02/Building/0467/2020 and TN/02/Building/0086/2023, 1,807 units, 9 towers x 13 floors, 7.46 acres, possession Mar 2025, 730-885 sqft 2/3 BHK at ~Rs 7,500/sqft, Rs 54.75-66.37 lakh) — it is NOT the same as Codename 'The Next Big Thing'. The latter is a genuinely new pre-launch opened around late July 2026, also in Thirumazhisai, 5 min from Poonamallee Bypass metro and on the ORR / Chennai-Bengaluru Expressway, offering 1,000+ premium 2 & 3 BHK homes with 100+ amenities; 250+ homes were reserved in the first seven days and 300+ channel partners are backing it. NO unit sizes, per-sqft rate, ticket price, acreage, possession date or RERA number have been published for the new project — only that limited launch inventory is 'valued at more than Rs 1,000 crore', which I deliberately have not converted into a per-unit price. Recommend splitting this into two records.
